evidence.title: Coalition MPs concede immigration pledge not fully costed by independent watchdog

occurrences.checkable_against: Parliamentary Budget Office rules and media clarification statements
occurrences.quote_span: PBO officials are not allowed to discuss costings for members of parliament but can choose to clarify references in media reports if they are incorrect or misrepresent PBO work.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Coalition immigration policy costing

occurrences.checkable_against: Angus Taylor's announcement and Coalition budget analysis
occurrences.quote_span: “We’ve been working closely with the Parliamentary Budget Office on analysis of our initiatives and we are confident that this package is budget neutral,” Taylor said announcing the plan on Tuesday.
occurrences.speaker: Angus Taylor
occurrences.subject: Coalition immigration policy costing

occurrences.checkable_against: Taylor and Hume public statements and Coalition immigration policy documents
occurrences.quote_span: Taylor, and the deputy Liberal leader, Jane Hume, have said repeatedly the Coalition “worked closely” with the independent budget watchdog on its plan to reduce net overseas migration to 100,000 for two years.
occurrences.speaker: Angus Taylor and Jane Hume
occurrences.subject: Coalition immigration policy costing

occurrences.checkable_against: Angus Taylor's Channel Nine interview and released budget analysis
occurrences.quote_span: Challenged over the release of PBO costings on Wednesday, Taylor told Channel Nine: “We’ve released the outcomes of that budget analysis that we’ve been doing …
occurrences.speaker: Angus Taylor
occurrences.subject: Coalition immigration policy costing

occurrences.checkable_against: Parliamentary Budget Office media response log
occurrences.quote_span: The PBO declined to comment on Wednesday.
occurrences.speaker: Parliamentary Budget Office
occurrences.subject: Coalition immigration policy costing

occurrences.checkable_against: Andrew McKellar and Australian Chamber of Commerce and Industry statements
occurrences.quote_span: Australian Chamber of Commerce and Industry boss, Andrew McKellar, rejected the planned cuts, arguing Australia had a housing supply problem, not an immigration problem.
occurrences.speaker: Andrew McKellar
occurrences.subject: Coalition immigration policy costing

occurrences.checkable_against: Parliamentary Budget Office costing records and Coalition immigration policy documents
occurrences.quote_span: Coalition MPs concede the party’s newly released immigration policy has not been costed in full by the Parliamentary Budget Office (PBO), despite Angus Taylor defending the plan as “budget neutral”.
occurrences.speaker: Coalition MPs
occurrences.subject: Coalition immigration policy costing

occurrences.checkable_against: Richard Marles's public remarks and Australian government immigration policy
occurrences.quote_span: “Immigration is absolutely central to this. We need to get the numbers right. We do need to manage them down. That’s what our government’s doing, but we need to do it in a way which can maintain our economy and maintain vital sectors like the defence industry here in Western Australia.”
occurrences.speaker: Richard Marles
occurrences.subject: Coalition immigration policy costing

occurrences.checkable_against: Angus Taylor office statements and Parliamentary Budget Office costing records
occurrences.quote_span: Taylor’s office said they planned to have the policy costed before the next federal election, but have used internal analysis and existing costings during the design process.
occurrences.speaker: Angus Taylor's office
occurrences.subject: Coalition immigration policy costing

occurrences.checkable_against: Richard Marles's public remarks and economic impact assessments of the Coalition plan
occurrences.quote_span: The acting prime minister, Richard Marles, warned that the Coalition plan would hurt agriculture, aged care and even defence.
occurrences.speaker: Richard Marles
occurrences.subject: Coalition immigration policy costing

occurrences.checkable_against: Angus Taylor's announcement and Labor modelling releases
occurrences.quote_span: He said the Coalition had “done exactly what the government does” and then accused Labor of not releasing modelling.
occurrences.speaker: Angus Taylor
occurrences.subject: Coalition immigration policy costing

occurrences.checkable_against: Coalition policy development records and Taylor office statements
occurrences.quote_span: Taylor’s office said they planned to have the policy costed before the next federal election, but have used internal analysis and existing costings during the design process.
occurrences.speaker: Angus Taylor's office
occurrences.subject: Coalition immigration policy costing

occurrences.checkable_against: Angus Taylor's Channel Nine interview and released budget analysis
occurrences.quote_span: “We have released the figures, and we’ve said it’s budget neutral, and we’ve laid that out.”
occurrences.speaker: Angus Taylor
occurrences.subject: Coalition immigration policy costing
